lines.zh: 蠕动前行，眼中闪烁绿光。
lines.en: Creeps forward, green eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 缓慢游走，发出沙哑低吟。
lines.en: Moves slowly, emitting a hoarse whisper.

lines.zh: 身体扭动，试图接近玩家。
lines.en: Body writhes, trying to approach the player.

lines.zh: 目光在黑暗中搜寻猎物。
lines.en: Eyes scan the darkness for prey.

lines.zh: 接近时低吼一声，威胁玩家。
lines.en: Grumbles lowly as it nears, threatening the player.

lines.zh: 寻找下一个目标，视线闪烁不定。
lines.en: Scans for the next target, eyes flickering.
Cold touch, creeping closer.

lines.zh: 在阴影中隐匿身形，等待时机。
lines.en: Hides in shadows, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 用触手摸索，试探玩家位置。
lines.en: Uses tentacles to feel out the player's position.
Moves in the shadows, biding its time.

lines.zh: 三格高的躯体踏过骨屑。
lines.en: My three-block frame crushes bone dust.
I skirt the monolith and keep drifting.
Breathes slowly, remaining still.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出微弱嘶鸣。
lines.en: Stares at the player, emitting a faint hiss.
Curls its body, as if in contemplation.
Remains still, waiting patiently.
Creeps slowly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，不敢轻易移动。
lines.en: Gazes at the player, not daring to move.
Inhales deeply, then remains still.
Eyes fixed, unmoving.

lines.zh: 保持警惕，随时准备出击。
lines.en: Keeps alert, ready to attack.
Relaxes its body, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 独石与先知堆成的我静止不动。
lines.en: Built from monolith and prophet, I stand still.

lines.zh: 虚空之眼在胸口微微发亮。
lines.en: The void eye in my chest glows faintly.

lines.zh: 三格高的影子投在血肉平原。
lines.en: My three-block shadow falls on the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 我守着失落文明的残迹。
lines.en: I keep watch over a lost civilization's remains.
Steadily watches the player.
Tracks the player, eyes burning.
Fixes on the player, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，不可动摇。
lines.en: Eyes lock onto the player, unyielding.

lines.zh: 死死盯住玩家，发出警告。
lines.en: Stares at the player, issuing a warning.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，身体微微前倾。
lines.en: Stares at the player, body leaning forward.

lines.zh: 目光锐利，观察玩家一举一动。
lines.en: Sharp eyes, observing the player's movements.

lines.zh: 全神贯注于玩家，毫不分神。
lines.en: Fully focused on the player, not distracted.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，几乎要抓住机会。
lines.en: Stares at the player, almost ready to strike.
Burning eyes, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 我的目光穿过骨荒原锁定你。
lines.en: My gaze crosses the bone wastes to you.

lines.zh: 你用虚空之眼造出了我。
lines.en: You built me with the void eye.

lines.zh: 镐尖的反光映进我的眼里。
lines.en: The glint of your pickaxe fills my eye.
Three blocks tall, I look down at you.

lines.zh: 我能看穿基岩下的黑暗。
lines.en: I see through the dark beneath the bedrock.
I have noted the light you carry.

lines.zh: 失落的文明也在看着我。
lines.en: The lost civilization watches through me.

lines.zh: 你站在骨堆上，太显眼了。
lines.en: Standing on the bones, you are obvious.

lines.zh: 我的视线绕过独石找到你。
lines.en: My sight rounds the monolith to find you.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进洞底就安全。
lines.en: Do not think the pit bottom hides you.
My eyes...
Blurred vision...
Incredible pain...
World goes dark...
Fear consumes me...
Void surrounds me...
My tentacles hurt...
Light fades away...
Cannot breathe...
My soul trembles...

lines.zh: 独石堆起来的我，也会看你。
lines.en: Built from monoliths, I still watch you.
Your presence is all I see.

lines.zh: 靠近我，让我的眼睛注视你。
lines.en: Come closer, let me gaze upon you.
Your world shall be mine.

lines.zh: 你用独石垒起我，我就盯上你。
lines.en: You stacked me from monoliths, so I fix on you.
Savor your power.
I long to see your fear.
Your presence awakens me.

lines.zh: 三格高的我，是用独石搭起来的。
lines.en: Three blocks tall, built from monoliths.
My tentacles shall touch you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，独石嗡了一声。
lines.en: You hit me, and the monolith hummed.
You move too fast.
Your presence interferes with me.
You knock my base half a block sideways.
I'm wedged in the doorway, unable to move.
My vision is obstructed.
Your interference is too strong.
You disrupt my vision.
I need to clear the obstacle.

lines.zh: 独石一摆，我就长出来了。
lines.en: Set a monolith, and I grow from it.

lines.zh: 守着我的人，还愿意再来吗？
lines.en: Will the one who built me come again?

lines.zh: 你砌的每一块石头都记得你。
lines.en: Every stone you laid remembers you.
We should unite.
You are my only haven.
Your presence awakens me
Our strength will be greater.
You understand my needs.

lines.zh: 我们的结合是命中注定。
lines.en: Our union is destined.
We need each other.

lines.zh: 独石与先知，也想要同类。
lines.en: Even monolith and prophet long for kin.
My sight, seeing all.

lines.zh: 你放下的祭品，我收下了。
lines.en: The offering you left, I accept.
Your hands shake, and the stones tremble.

lines.zh: 你在这里，就该为我所用。
lines.en: You're here, for my use.

lines.zh: 你身上有我需要的东西。
lines.en: You have what I need.

lines.zh: 我能看到你的每一个心跳。
lines.en: I see every beat of your heart.
You can't hide in the dark.
You're just my prey.

lines.zh: 你的世界，就是我的舞台。
lines.en: Your world, my stage.
Yours, forever mine.
You stacked me with your own hands.
You'll taste my power soon.
Your struggle is futile.
You can't escape my sight.
The monolith base begins to warm.
You're just another prey.
Your screams will echo.
You'll serve me.
I keep watch inside the wall you built.
You'll be used by me.

lines.zh: 血肉平原上的活物，归我。
lines.en: The living on the flesh plains are mine.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我的视线范围。
lines.en: You stepped into my field of sight.

lines.zh: 骨荒原没有遮掩，你无处躲。
lines.en: The bone wastes hide nothing, not even you.
The prophet said you would come.
My sight is tethered to you.

lines.zh: 虚空之眼替我盯住了你。
lines.en: The void eye holds you for me.

lines.zh: 我认得你搬来的每块石头。
lines.en: I know every stone you hauled here.
Monoliths built me. My eyes are lit.
Your death is inevitable.
The monolith rose. So did I.
You'll witness my power.

lines.zh: 你只是我力量的一部分。
lines.en: You're just a part of my power.

lines.zh: 你亲手立起我，就该知道我会看。
lines.en: You raised me yourself, you knew I would watch.
You'll serve me
Your death will be remembered.
You'll be used by me

lines.zh: 我会一路追到基岩洞口。
lines.en: I will chase you to the bedrock hole.
Your pickaxe swing is far too slow.

lines.zh: 血肉平原会记住你的味道。
lines.en: The flesh plains will remember your taste.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的风替我数你的脚步。
lines.en: The bone wind counts your steps for me.

lines.zh: 你逃不出失落文明的边界。
lines.en: You cannot leave the lost civilization's edge.
The void churns inside my body.

lines.zh: 我看见你握紧武器的手在抖。
lines.en: I see your grip trembling on your weapon.

lines.zh: 独石指向你，你无路可走。
lines.en: The monolith points at you. No road left.

lines.zh: 三格高的身影正压向你。
lines.en: My three-block bulk bears down on you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear every breath you take.

lines.zh: 独石的手臂抓住你的脚踝。
lines.en: A monolith arm seizes your ankle.

lines.zh: 你是用独石把我堆起来的。
lines.en: You stacked me out of monoliths yourself.

lines.zh: 你堆我时，可没想过这个。
lines.en: You never thought of this while stacking me.
Your pick rings on the monolith.

lines.zh: 石头垒成的我，也会抓人。
lines.en: I am stacked of stone, and I still grab.
You won't get away!
Your blood will nourish me!

lines.zh: 你的痛苦就是我的喜悦！
lines.en: Your pain is my joy!

lines.zh: 独石拼成的我，被镐敲才会动。
lines.en: Built of monoliths, only a pick moves me.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的碎骨扎进你皮肉！
lines.en: Bone shards from the wastes pierce your skin!

lines.zh: 我三格高的手臂砸下来了！
lines.en: My three-block arm comes crashing down!
Take the strength the monolith gave me!
One pickaxe blow, and I remember it!
The flesh plains lack your flesh!
The prophet taught me this blow!
Do not run back to the bedrock layer!
Darkness calls me forth!
The gaze from the void watches you!

lines.zh: 三格高的柱子，猎物在附近。
lines.en: A three-block pillar, and the prey is near.
Death awaits you!
The void eye guides me!

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，我的猎物！
lines.en: You are my prey, my prey!
Dark light guides me!

lines.zh: 你用独石把我搭起来，怪谁。
lines.en: You built me from monoliths. Blame yourself.
Darkness shadows you!
Fear will be your constant companion!

lines.zh: 独石、先知、虚空之眼，拼成我！
lines.en: Monolith, prophet, void eye: I am assembled!
I rise from the pit at zero, zero!

lines.zh: 三格高的身影立在骨荒原上！
lines.en: A three-block shape stands on the bone wastes!

lines.zh: 血肉平原的泥土在震动！
lines.en: The soil of the flesh plains trembles!
One right-click, and I wake!
The void eye opens; I arrive!
The lost civilization returns through me!
Beneath the bones, I slowly stand!

lines.zh: 你亲手拼成的我，如今醒来！
lines.en: Your own hands made me, and now I wake!

lines.zh: 基岩之下的目光照到这里！
lines.en: The gaze beneath the bedrock reaches here!
Flames burn my tentacles...
Fell from a height...
Water drowns my tentacles...

lines.zh: 冲击波撕裂了我的身体…
lines.en: Explosion tears my body...
Arrow pierces my eye...
Magic consumes me...
Hunger devours my mind...
Lightning strikes me...
Void devours me...
